blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Moving from controllable videos to genuinely playable worlds requires persistent world state, executable game rules, and low-latency interaction. We outline a roadmap for the next generation of Matrix-Game that separates game execution from visual generation through an executable game harness, and introduce Matrix-Game 4.0 as the first system built on this design. A lightweight game engine maintains world state and executes interaction rules, a multimodal coding agent translates player ideas into game code and dynamic scene captions, and a renderer based on autoregressive video model transforms engine-rendered low-poly proxies into detailed visuals, conditioned on dynamic captions and memory references. This framework provides continuous guidance for visual generation and enables natural-language creation and modification of scenes and gameplay. Our renderer is trained on aligned low-poly and high-fidelity video pairs and distilled into a causal generator that generates in four-frame chunks with one or two denoising steps. Together with targeted inference optimizations, Matrix-Game 4.0 enables 480p, 60 FPS gameplay on a single NVIDIA RTX5090 with a key-press-to-display latency of 112ms. Single-step generation achieves 83FPS steady-state throughput with 18.2GiB of peak GPU memory usage. With fixed prompts, steady-state throughput also reaches 67FPS on an RTX5080 and 58FPS on an RTX5070Ti. We demonstrate customizable shooter and driving games with engine-enforced mechanics, and release code, model weights, and low-poly game assets to support research and creation of playable game worlds.
blocks.zh: 从可控视频向真正可玩世界转变需要持续的世界状态,可执行的游戏规则,以及低常态互动. 我们勾勒出下一代Matrix-Game的路线图,通过可执行的游戏杠杆将游戏执行与视觉生成区分开来,并引入Matrix-Game 4.0作为这个设计上的第一个系统. 轻量级游戏引擎维持世界状态并执行交互规则,多模式编码代理将玩家的想法翻译为游戏代码和动态场景字幕,基于自递式视频模型的渲染器将引擎的低波代理转换为详细的视觉,以动态字幕和内存引用为条件. 这个框架为视觉生成提供了持续的指导,并使得自然语言的创作和修改场景和游戏游戏成为可能. 我们的渲染器被训练成对齐的低孔和高纯度视频对,并蒸馏成一个因果生成器,在四帧块中产生一个或两个去诺步骤. 结合定向推论优化,Matrix-Game 4.0在单NVIDIA RTX5090上启用480p,60FPS游戏机,按键-按压-显示时速112ms. 单步生成以18.2GiB的峰值GPU内存使用量实现83FPS稳态吞吐量. 有了固定的提示,稳定的状态吞吐量在RTX5080上也达到67FPS,在RTX5070Ti上达到58FPS. 我们用引擎强化力学演示自定义的射击手和驾驶游戏,并演示发行码,模型重量,以及低孔游戏资产,以支持可玩游戏世界的研究和创造.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Interactive world models such as the Genie series Bruce et al. (2024) ; Parker-Holder et al. (2024) ; Ball et al. (2025) extend generative modeling from producing videos for passive viewing to creating worlds for active interaction, demonstrating that interactive environments can be generated on the fly Valevski et al. (2024) ; Decart (2024) ; He et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026) ; Qian et al. (2026) . However, as the goal shifts from brief exploration to long-running games with rich gameplay and controllable rules, systems that rely primarily on video generation to maintain world state face four key challenges.

blocks.en: • No continuous external correction. Model rollouts proceed largely in isolation from external environments. World state exists implicitly in generated pixels and model context, without explicit state being continuously maintained for regions outside the field of view. • Accumulating errors. Without external correction, small errors compound through autoregressive generation, progressively degrading consistency. Even with external 3D tools, errors in estimated camera poses can accumulate and eventually cause scene collapse. • Uncompressed frame-based memory. Historical frames accumulate without their spatial information being consolidated into a compact representation. Memory costs therefore grow with rollout length, limiting long-horizon generation. • Limited gameplay mechanics. Interaction centers on navigation and basic environmental responses, with limited support for executable rules, persistent action consequences, and explicit objectives that users can actively pursue.

blocks.en: More fundamentally, diffusion models primarily learn statistical correlations: visual realism does not necessarily imply causal or physical understanding. Following Roman Jakobson’s tripartite classification Jakobson (2021) , the language-to-visual mapping in text- and image-to-video (TI2V) generation can be viewed as intersemiotic translation . We argue that current video generators are not yet vision foundation models for world modeling: much of their semantic understanding and apparent intelligence comes from upstream multimodal language models (MLLMs) or text encoders, while diffusion acts more like a renderer. Yet addressing these limitations alone is insufficient: genuinely playable worlds also require real-time generation with low interaction latency, meaningful game mechanics and rich interactions beyond navigation, and shared world state for multiplayer interaction. These considerations motivate an architecture where an external system maintains persistent world state and executes interaction rules, while the video model focuses on visual rendering.
blocks.zh: 更为根本的是,传播模型主要学习统计相关:视觉现实主义并不一定意味着因果关系或物理理解. 按照罗曼·雅科布森的三方分类雅科布森(2021年),文本和图像到视频(TI2V)生成中的语言到视觉映射可以看作是跨语言翻译. 我们主张,目前的视频生成器还不是世界建模的视觉基础模型:其语义理解和显性智能大多来自上游多模式语言模型(MLLMs)或文本编码器,而传播则更像是渲染器. 然而,仅仅解决这些限制是不够的:真正的可玩性世界也需要实时生成,互动性低、有意义的游戏力学和超越导航的丰富互动,以及多人互动的共同世界状态。 这些考虑激励了一个架构,一个外部系统保持持续的世界状态并执行交互规则,而视频模型则侧重于视觉渲染.

blocks.en:
We introduce Matrix-Game 4.0 , a framework that places a video generation model within an external harness to separate game logic from visual generation. The system has three components (Figure 2 ). The multimodal coding agent translates player ideas into runnable game code and scene descriptions. The game engine maintains world state, executes interaction rules, and renders simplified geometry as structural rendering (i.e. low-poly proxy). The video generation model transforms this proxy into detailed frames with materials, lighting, and atmosphere. At runtime, player actions update the engine state; the engine outputs proxy frames and structural, motion, and dynamic semantic conditions; and the video generation model renders the detailed frames displayed to the player. These continuous external guidance from the game engine provides a basis for correct rendering, such that the game no longer relies on the video generation model’s memory to maintain world state or execute rules. Our main contributions are as follows: • Real-time, playable video generation on a single consumer GPU. Matrix-Game 4.0 enables 480p, 60 FPS gameplay on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090, with 112 ms of key-press-to-display latency. Single-step denoising achieves 83 FPS steady-state generation throughput with approximately 18.2 GiB of peak GPU memory usage, making video-model-driven games practical for local deployment and real-time interaction. (Table 3 ) With fixed prompts, single-step generation also reaches approximately 67 FPS on an RTX 5080 and 58 FPS on an RTX 5070 Ti, extending deployment to consumer GPUs with 16 GiB of memory. • A roadmap toward playable worlds. We outline Matrix-Game V4’s roadmap, separating game execution from visual generation through an executable harness. It combines a lightweight engine for world-state maintenance and rule execution, a multimodal agent for creating and modifying gameplay and scenes, and an autoregressive video model for real-time rendering, advancing from controllable videos to playable and extensible worlds. • A reusable pipeline spanning data, training, and runtime. We integrate data collection of paired proxy-detailed frames and dynamic captions, model training for video rendering, few-step autoregressive distillation, and efficient real-time inference. • An open-source foundation for generative games. We open-source Matrix-Game 4.0 at launch. For researchers, it provides
a reusable technical foundation for further exploration of this
emerging paradigm, combining executable game harnesses with
video-model-based rendering. For game developers, it offers a
concrete preview of how coding agents and neural rendering can
support future game-development workflows, while lowering the
barrier to prototyping and customizing scenes, interactions,
and gameplay through natural-language instructions.

blocks.en: 2 Roadmap
blocks.zh: 2 路线图

blocks.en: Matrix-Game V4 aims to build a truly playable world. Based on the analysis above, our approach is to wrap the video model in a harness that maintains world state and provides an executable foundation for gameplay . This architecture brings together three modules: a game engine, a multimodal coding agent, and a video generation model. The game engine serves as an external game manager, supplying spatial layout references, defining game rules, managing world state, and updating the semantic context. The multimodal coding agent bridges players’ ideas and game code, enabling flexible creation and modification of both gameplay and scenes. The video model then integrates the resulting context and control signals to autoregressively generate short sequences of realistic future frames. Figure 2 shows how the three parts work together.
blocks.zh: Matrix-Game V4旨在建立一个真正可玩的世界. 基于上述分析,我们的方法是将视频模型包裹在一个能维持世界状态并为游戏游戏提供可执行的基础的绳索上. 这个架构汇集了三个模块:一个游戏引擎,一个多式联运编码代理,和一个视频生成模型. 游戏引擎充当外部游戏管理器,提供空间布局参考,定义游戏规则,管理世界状态,更新语义上下文. 多式联运编码代理连接了玩家的想法和游戏代码,使得游戏游戏和场景都能够灵活创作和修改. 视频模型随后整合了由此产生的上下文和控制信号,以自动生成现实未来帧的短序列. 图2显示三个部分如何合作。

blocks.en: 2.1 Game Engine: The World’s “Referee”
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 游戏引擎:世界的“参考”

blocks.en: The engine keeps track of what actually happens in the world and determines the consequences of player actions. Rather than producing fully detailed visuals, it represents roads, buildings, characters, and interactive objects through simplified geometry and scene structures. Game state and rules—including health, inventory, gravity, collisions, and quest progress—are explicitly maintained and enforced in code, rather than inferred from generated images.
blocks.zh: 引擎不断跟踪世界实际发生的情况,并确定玩家行动的后果. 它不产生完全详细的视觉,而是通过简化几何和场景结构来代表道路,建筑物,人物,以及交互式物体. 游戏状态和规则——包括健康、库存、重力、碰撞和探索进展——在代码中得到明确维护和执行,而不是从生成的图像中推断出来。

blocks.en: As players act, the engine continuously updates the world and outputs structural renderings. These act as dynamic “scene sketches,” providing the video model with constraints on spatial layout, object motion, and camera viewpoint. Even when an object leaves the field of view, its state is still maintained by the engine according to the game rules.
blocks.zh: 随着玩家的行动,引擎不断更新世界,输出结构渲染. 它们是动态的“场景草图”,为视频模型提供空间布局、物体运动和摄像头角度的限制。 即使物体离开视野,其状态仍由引擎按照游戏规则维持.

blocks.en: 2.2 Multimodal Coding Agent: The World’s “Scriptwriter” and “Translator”
blocks.zh: 2.2 多式联运编码代理商:世界的 " 编译员 " 和 " 翻译员 "

blocks.en: The Multimodal Coding Agent provides the system’s intelligence and imagination, while also constructing its game rules. It communicates with the engine in both directions: translating established scenes and events into visual descriptions, and bringing players’ ideas or its own creative proposals into the game world.
blocks.zh: 多式联运编码代理公司提供系统的智能和想象力,同时也构建其游戏规则. 它与引擎进行双向交流:将既定的场景和事件转化为视觉描述,并将玩家的想法或自己的创意提议带入游戏世界.

blocks.en: The agent converts engine-defined scene structures and interaction outcomes into text descriptions that guide video generation. With a reference image, a simple box can be described as “an old thatched cottage weathered by sea winds, with a dark red wooden front door.” When a player shoots an oil barrel, the engine determines whether the shot hits and triggers an explosion; the agent only describes the resulting visuals.
blocks.zh: 代理将引擎定义的场景结构和互动结果转换成指导视频生成的文字描述. 用一个参考图像,一个简单的盒子可以描述为“一个被海风吹过的老旧的茅屋,有一个深红色的木头门。” 当玩家射击油桶时,引擎会决定射击是否命中并触发爆炸;代理机只描述了由此产生的视觉.

blocks.en:
The agent adds content and rules to the engine in two ways.
When players have a specific idea, the agent turns it into a working game. From reshaping terrain and placing objects to modifying NPC behavior and designing new mechanics, it implements requests by editing scene configurations and game code. For example, “make monsters swarm in from all directions” requires more than adding monsters: it also means defining where they spawn, how they move and attack, and what determines victory or defeat.
When players leave the details open, the agent improvises based on the existing scene and interaction context, filling in spatial layouts, storylines, or NPC dialogue. For example, a player might open a door with no predefined content behind it. The agent can imagine “a storage room with a locked iron chest in the corner” and submit it to the engine to be registered in the world. From that point on, the engine maintains the chest’s state and determines whether it can be opened.
blocks.zh:
代理机在引擎中以两种方式添加内容和规则.
当玩家有具体想法时,代理将它转化为工作游戏. 从重塑地形和放置物体到修改NPC行为和设计新的力学,它通过编辑场景配置和游戏代码来执行请求. 例如,“使怪物从各个方向聚集起来”不仅需要增加怪物:它还意味着界定它们产卵地点、它们如何移动和攻击以及什么决定胜利或失败。
当玩家离开细节时,代理机会根据现有的场景和互动背景进行即兴表演,填充空间布局,故事情节,或NPC对话. 例如,玩家可能会打开一个没有预定义内容的门. 特工可以想象“一个储藏室,在角落里有一个锁着的铁箱”,并把它交给全世界登记的发动机。 从此,引擎保持胸部状态,决定能否打开.

blocks.en: 2.3 Video Generation Model: The World’s “Painter”
blocks.zh: 2.3 视频生成 型号 : 世界的 " 灯塔 "

blocks.en: The video model transforms structural renderings into rich, detailed visuals. While preserving scene structure and motion constraints, it generates materials, lighting, atmosphere, and fine visual details, reducing the need to create high-fidelity 3D assets individually.
blocks.zh: 视频模型将结构渲染转化为丰富,详细的视觉. 在保留场景结构和运动约束的同时,它会产生材料,照明,大气,以及精细的视觉细节,减少了单独创建高真性3D资产的需求.

blocks.en: Conditioned on current control inputs and past frames, the model continuously generates video through causal autoregression. Few-step distillation and inference optimizations tailored to real-time re-rendering reduce the delay between player actions and visual feedback.
blocks.zh: 以当前控制输入和过去帧为条件,该模型通过因果自旋不断生成视频. 很少步骤的蒸馏和推论优化适合实时重报,减少玩家动作和视觉反馈之间的延迟.

blocks.en: The real-time loop can be summarized as: Player input → \rightarrow Engine updates world state → \rightarrow Structural renderings and control signals → \rightarrow Real-time video rendering → \rightarrow Visual feedback to the player .
blocks.zh: 实时循环可以概括为: 玩家输入 ^\右翼引擎更新世界状态 →\右翼结构渲染和控制信号 →\右翼实时视频渲染 →\右翼视觉反馈给玩家.

blocks.en: The key is to separate how the game runs from how it looks: code defines the rules, the engine maintains state, and the video model generates the visuals. The engine only needs to run a lightweight simulation, leaving video generation as the main real-time performance challenge—one that can be mitigated through few-step distillation and causal autoregressive inference. Multiple players can share the same world state, each seeing it from their own perspective. As AI coding agents become more capable, the barrier to building lightweight games continues to fall, making this approach increasingly practical. Through this division of responsibilities, Matrix-Game V4 aims to help more people turn their ideas into games that can be played, modified, and continually refined—moving game world models from “controllable videos” to “executable worlds.”
blocks.zh: 关键是区分游戏如何运行与外观:代码定义规则,引擎维持状态,视频模型生成视觉. 引擎只需要运行一个轻量级模拟,留下视频生成作为主要的实时性能挑战——它可以通过几步蒸馏和因果自递性推论来缓解. 多个玩家可以分享同一个世界状态,各自从自己的视角来看待. 随着AI编码代理能力增强,建造轻量级游戏的障碍不断下降,使得这种方法越来越实用. 通过这一责任分工,Matrix-Game V4旨在帮助更多的人将想法转化为可以玩、修改和不断改进的游戏——将游戏世界模型从“可控视频”转移到“可执行的世界”。 “

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: 3.1 Paired Low-Poly and High-Fidelity Capture
blocks.zh: 3.1 Paired低保质度和高保质度捕获

blocks.en: We build a cross-domain dataset of aligned low-poly and high-fidelity videos in Unreal Engine 5 (UE5) Epic Games (2024) for world modeling and video generation. It covers four representative scene types: the CitySample megacity Epic Games (2022) , an open desert, a complex castle, and high-dynamic air combat. Table 1 lists the training data of each scene. Every capture is recorded at 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 and contains three aligned videos (the UE5 RGB render, the low-poly structure render, and a depth render of the proxy geometry) plus a per-frame metadata record. Shooter and air-combat clips last about one minute. For the castle, desert, and city scenes we hold out three complete capture sessions, and for air combat we hold out whole capture batches; no held-out session contributes any training clip.
blocks.zh: 我们在不真实引擎5(UE5)Epic Games(2024)为世界建模和视频生成构建一个对齐的低孔和高真视频的跨域数据集. 它涵盖了四个代表性的场景类型:CitySample超大城市Epic Games (2022),一个开放的沙漠,一个复杂的城堡,以及高动力的空气战斗. 表1列出了每个场景的培训数据. 每个捕获记录在1280×720 1280\times 720,包含三个对齐的视频(UE5 RGB渲染,低孔结构渲染,以及代理几何的深度渲染)加上一个每帧元数据记录. 射击机和空战弹夹持续约1分钟. 对于城堡,沙漠,和城市的场景,我们举行了三次完整的捕捉会议,对于空中战斗,我们举行了整个捕捉批次;没有举行任何培训会议。

blocks.en: Table 1 : UE5 paired training data. Each clip is a pair of pixel-aligned low-poly and high-fidelity videos at 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 . Held-out clips come from capture sessions (for air combat, whole multi-machine capture batches) that contribute no training clip.
blocks.zh: 表1:UE5配对培训数据。 每段片段都是一对像素对齐的低孔和高真视频,拍摄时间为1280×720 1280\times 720. 被搁置的片段来自捕捉环节(用于空战,整个多机捕捉批次),不提供训练片段.

blocks.en: The capture pipeline abstracts each high-complexity scene into a lightweight geometric representation. Camera trajectories and timestamps are strictly synchronized between the two renders, so the low-poly structure frame and the high-fidelity frame of the same index are aligned pixel by pixel (Figure 3 a). The structure representation keeps the spatial topology, the rigid poses, and the motion trajectories of the scene. For buildings, complex terrain, vegetation, and dynamic interactive objects, adaptive geometric fitting and view-frustum culling remove material reflections, high-frequency textures, and complex lighting, so the structure prior describes only the essential spatial geometry. In the resulting proxy the sky is black and the ground is a gray checkerboard; buildings and walls become flat-colored boxes and prisms, trees become a cylinder with a sphere, characters become figures made of blocks, and every primitive is drawn with a black outline and no texture, reflection, or shadow (left part of each split frame in Figure 1 ). In parallel, the system records object instance IDs, visibility states, and causal interaction events, forming a semantic metadata stream for every clip. The data defines a conditional mapping from lightweight geometric topology to high-fidelity visuals, and gives deterministic supervision for spatiotemporal consistency and interaction stability in long rollouts.
blocks.zh: 捕捉管道将每个高复杂度场景编成轻量级几何表示. 相机的轨迹和时间戳在二者之间严格同步,因此同一指数的低孔结构框架和高密结构框架都以像素对齐像素(图3 a). 结构代表保持了空间地形,刚性姿势,以及场景的运动轨迹. 对于建筑,复杂的地形,植被,以及动态交互物体,适应性的几何配置和视野-frustum culling去除物质反射,高频纹理,以及复杂的照明,所以之前的结构只描述基本的空间几何. 在由此产生的代理中,天空是黑色的,地面是灰色的跳板;建筑和墙体成为平面彩色的盒子和棱镜,树成为圆柱形的球体,人物成为由块组成的数字,每个原始画上都有一个黑色的轮廓,没有纹理,反射,也没有阴影(图1中每个分割框的左部分). 同时,系统记录对象实例ID,能见度状态,以及因果互动事件,为每个片段组成一个语义元数据流. 数据定义了从轻量级几何地形学到高真实度视觉学的有条件映射,并在长展中为瞬间一致性和相互作用稳定性提供了决定性的监督.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dynamic Captions
blocks.zh: 3.2 动态说明

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Dynamic captions follow the engine state. Top: low-poly proxy frames of one CitySample driving clip; numbered markers are the visible objects that the engine reports for this frame, each linked by its instance ID to a semantic description. Below: the caption that the rule-based template produces for the same frame, without any vision-language model. Orange text comes from object states and events, and blue text from object positions and distances. As the car moves, parked vehicles leave the description, pedestrians change from standing to approaching, and newly visible objects are announced under “Changes”.
blocks.zh: 图4:动态标题跟随引擎状态. 顶部:一个CitySample驱动剪辑的低孔代理帧;编号标记是引擎报告这个帧的可见对象,每个标记通过实例ID链接到一个语义描述. 下面:基于规则的模板为同一帧制作的字幕,没有任何视觉语言模型. 橙色文本来自物体状态和事件,蓝色文本来自物体位置和距离. 随着汽车的移动,停放的车辆离开描述,行人从站立到接近,并在“变化”下公布新可见物体。

blocks.en: In an interactive game the picture changes with every player action. Turning the camera changes which objects are visible, and moving or triggering events changes the state of objects. A fixed text description cannot follow these changes, so Matrix-Game 4.0 uses dynamic captions: the description given to the video model is updated with the current state of the game world.
blocks.zh: 在互动游戏中,画面随每个玩家动作而变化. 移动或触发事件会改变物体的状态。 固定的文字描述无法跟随这些变化,因此Matrix-Game 4.0使用动态标题:给视频模型的描述随游戏世界的当前状态而更新.

blocks.en: Each object in the scene has an ID that is linked to a semantic description. The system reads the currently visible objects and their real-time states from the game engine and fills them into a prompt template, producing a description that matches the current frame (Figure 3 b). When the player changes the view, enters a new area, or triggers an event, the description is reorganized, so the video model always receives the latest semantic condition (Figure 4 ). The dynamic caption and the low-poly proxy complement each other. The proxy supplies structure: position, layout, and motion. The caption supplies semantics: which objects are in the frame and what state each is in. Together they constrain generation, so the frames follow the scene structure produced by the engine and also follow changes in events and object states.
blocks.zh: 场景中的每个物体都有与语义描述相连的ID. 系统从游戏引擎中读取目前可见的对象及其实时状态,并将其填充到一个即时模板中,生成一个符合当前框架的描述(图3 b). 当玩家改变视图,进入新区域,或触发事件时,描述被重组,因此视频模型总是收到最新的语义条件(图4). 动态标题和低孔代理互补. 代理供给结构:位置,布局,和运动. 标题提供语义:框中哪些对象以及每个对象的状态。 它们共同制约生成,因此帧遵循引擎产生的场景结构,也跟踪事件和对象状态的变化.

Four inputs condition each chunk, and each has its own job: • The low-poly proxy rendered by the engine is concatenated with the latent video being generated along the channel dimension. blocks.en: 4.2 Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 4.2 监督的微调

blocks.en: We train one model per game. Starting from the Wan2.2-Fun-5B Control weights, the model is fine-tuned as a bidirectional video-to-video model with the flow-matching objective of Wan, on 81-frame windows of the paired data at 704 × 1280 704\times 1280 . Each window is conditioned on its low-poly proxy, its caption, the first frame, and up to three context frames that serve as spatial memory. The context frames are taken from at least 40 frames before the window: candidates whose view overlaps the window are kept, and the closest ones by camera pose are selected. They enter the sequence as clean latents with timestep 0 and are excluded from the loss. To support classifier-free guidance and generation without a given first frame, the first frame is dropped with probability 0.3, the prompt with probability 0.2, and the proxy control with probability 0.2. Training uses 64 GPUs with a global batch of 64, AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and 4,000 steps.
blocks.zh: 我们每场比赛训练一个模特儿 从Wan2.2-Fun-5B开始 控制权重,该模型作为双向视频到视频模型进行微调,以Wan的流量比对目标,在配对数据的81帧窗口上以704×1280 704\times 1280. 每个窗口都以它的低孔代理,其标题,第一个框架,以及最多三个充当空间内存的上下文框架为条件. 上下文框架取自窗口前的至少40帧:其视图与窗口保持重叠的候选者,通过相机姿势选择最接近的. 它们作为清洁的潜伏物进入序列,时间步为0,并被排除在损失之外。 为了支持没有给定第一个帧的无分类器引导和生成,第一个帧以概率0.3降低,以概率0.2降低,以概率0.2降低,以概率0.2降低代理控制. 训练使用64GPU,全球批量64,亚当W,学习率10−5 10^{-5},4000步.

blocks.en: 4.3 Causal Few-Step Distillation
blocks.zh: 4.3 低步挥发

blocks.en: Following Causal Forcing++ Zhao et al. (2026) , we convert the bidirectional model into a causal autoregressive generator that denoises one chunk (one latent frame) at a time with one or two steps. The three stages below run at 480 × 864 480\times 864 on 81-frame windows with 64 GPUs and a global batch of 64.
blocks.zh: 追随 Causal 强制++ Zhao et al. (2026),我们把双向模型转换成一个因果自旋式生成器,一次一个块(一个潜伏框),一个或两个步骤. 以下三个阶段运行于81帧窗口上的480×86480\时,共64台GPU,全球批量64台.

blocks.en: Starting from the fine-tuned model, each latent frame receives its own noise level and attends only to the clean ground-truth frames before it, the first frame, and the context frames. The model is trained with the same flow-matching loss for 20,000 steps at a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} . The result is a causal teacher that samples each chunk with a multi-step ODE solver.
blocks.zh: 从微调模型开始,每个潜在框架都得到自己的噪声级别,并且只注意它面前的干净的地面真实框架,第一个框架,以及上下文框架. 该型号在2万步中以同样的流量匹配损失进行训练,学习速度为2×10−6 2\times 10×6}. 结果是一个因果导师,用多步 ODE 解析器对每个块进行取样.

blocks.en: A frozen copy of the causal teacher, an online student, and an EMA student start from the same weights. On a grid of 48 noise levels, the teacher takes one Euler step with classifier-free guidance of 3 from a noisy chunk to the next lower level; the online student predicts the clean chunk from the higher level and is trained to match the EMA student’s prediction from the lower level. After 5,000 steps with an EMA decay of 0.99, the EMA student generates a chunk in four steps.
blocks.zh: 一份冻结的因果教师副本,一名在线学生,一名EMA学生从相同的重量开始. 在48个噪音等级的网格上,老师采取一个Euler步骤,从吵闹的块到下一个低年级的无分类指导为3;在线学生从高年级预测干净的块,并经过培训与EMA的学生从低年级的预测相匹配. 经过5000步,EMA衰减0.99,EMA学生在4步产生一个块.

blocks.en: The student then learns from its own autoregressive rollouts with asymmetric DMD Yin et al. (2024b) ; Yin et al. (2024a) ; Yin et al. (2025) . The real score is the frozen bidirectional model with classifier-free guidance, v c + 3 ​ ( v c − v u ) v_{\text{c}}+3\,(v_{\text{c}}-v_{\text{u}}) ; the fake score is initialized from the same weights and trained online. The fake score is updated at every step and the student every five steps, with learning rates of 4 × 10 − 7 4\times 10^{-7} and 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} . The student denoises each chunk in two steps and the first generated latent frame in four. Our latest recipe adds three changes that match the deployed inference setting. The student rolls out 21, 41, 61, or 121 latent frames with a rolling cache of the first frame and the latest 20 latent frames, and the two scores evaluate the last 21. At the start of every 20-frame segment, up to three spatial-memory frames are retrieved by camera pose and their keys and values join the cache. Because the deployed system encodes the proxy with TAEHV, the student receives TAEHV-encoded control on 80% of the steps and Wan-VAE-encoded control on the rest, while both scores always see the Wan-VAE encoding. This stage runs for 1,000 steps from the end of Stage 2.
blocks.zh: 学生然后用非对称的DMD学习自旋式推出 Yin等人(2024年b); Yin等人(2024a); 殷等 (2025) (中文(简体) ). 真正的分数是带有分类无主导的冰冻双向模型,v c + 3 (v c − v u) v_{\ text{c}}+3\,(v_{\ text{c}}-v_{\ text{u}});假分数从相同重量开始初始化,在线训练. 假分每步刷新,学生每5步刷新,学习率为4×10−7 4\times 10×7}2×10×6 2\times 10×6}. 学生们分两步走,第一步走四步走 我们最新的食谱增加了三个变化,与部署的推论环境相吻合。 学生们推出21,41,61,或121个潜伏帧,并带有第一个帧和最近20个潜伏帧的滚动缓存,两个分数评价最后21个. 在每20帧片段开始时,通过相机姿势检索到多达3个空间-元帧,它们的键和值加入缓存. 由于部署的系统将代理编码为TAEHV,学生在80%的台阶上获得TAEHV编码控制,其余的Wan-VAE编码控制,而两个分数总是看到Wan-VAE编码. 本舞台从第二阶段末期跑出1000步.

blocks.en: The rendering model generates one chunk at a time, and a chunk is one latent frame, i.e., four video frames. Short chunks keep the response to an action short, and they also make model calls frequent: with a single denoising step, each call does little arithmetic, and the GPU spends a large share of its time waiting for the CPU to launch kernels. We remove these costs in the order listed in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 渲染模型一次生成一个块,一个块是一个潜伏的帧,即四个视频帧. 短块保持对一个动作的响应短,它们也使模型调用频繁:用一个单一的去诺音步骤,每个调用都做很少算术,GPU花大量时间等待CPU发射内核. 我们按表2所列顺序删除这些费用。

blocks.en: The computation of the DiT backbone is recorded once as a CUDA Graph NVIDIA (2024) and replayed in a single launch at run time. Linear layers use 8-bit (FP8) weights Micikevicius et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh: DiT主干线的计算一度被记录为CUDA Graph NVIDIA (2024),并在运行时间一次发射中重播. 线性地层使用8位(FP8)重的Micikevicius等人(2022).

blocks.en: We write fused GPU kernels in Triton Tillet et al. (2019) for RoPE, normalization, and FP8 quantization. The query, key, and value projections of a layer share one quantization of their input. The key and value tensors of the text condition are cached and recomputed only when the caption changes.
blocks.zh: 我们在Triton Tillet等人(2019年)中为RoPE、正常化和FP8量化撰写了整合的GPU内核。 一个层的查询、密钥和值预测共享其投入的定量。 文本条件的密钥和值的开关仅在标题更改时才被缓存和重算 。

blocks.en: The key/value cache of the video history is a ring buffer: when the window slides, the newest latent frame overwrites the oldest slot in place and no history is moved. Self-attention splits the KV window into parts that are computed in parallel and merged Dao et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 视频历史的密钥/值缓存是一个环缓冲器:当窗口滑动时,最新的潜伏框架会覆盖最古老的位置槽,没有移动历史. 自觉将KV窗口分割成平行计算的部分,并合并了Dao等人(2023年).

blocks.en: The full Wan VAE decoder is replaced by the lightweight TAEHV decoder Boer Bohan (2025) , and model input and output run in an asynchronous pipeline.
blocks.zh: 完整的Wan VAE解码器被轻量级的TAEHV解码器Boer Bohan(2025)取代,模型输入和输出运行在同步管道中.

blocks.en: Together these changes raise the steady-state rate from 4.5 to 83.4 FPS (19 × \times ) and cut the key-to-frame latency from 1110 ms to 112 ms (9.9 × \times ). Measuring model inference alone on one RTX 5090 at 480p, the steady-state generation rate is about 83 FPS with one denoising step and about 57 FPS with two, and the peak memory is about 18.2 GiB in both cases. With one step, the model denoises one four-frame chunk in 48 ms. The text encoder, the DiT, and the VAE all reside on the same card.
blocks.zh: 这些变化加在一起将稳态速率从4.5升至83.4 FPS(19 × \times ),并将按键到帧的空位从1110 ms降低至112 ms(9.9 × \times ). 仅在480p的1个RTX 5090上测量模型推论,稳态生成率大约为83个FPS,有1个去诺音阶,约57个FPS有2个,峰值内存大约为18.2 GiB两种情况. 只要一步 模型就能在48毫秒的距离内 得到一个四帧的碎片 文本编码器,DiT和VAE都居住在同一个卡上.

steady-state generation throughput reaches approximately 67 FPS
on an RTX 5080 and 58 FPS on an RTX 5070 Ti, with GPU memory usage of approximately 12.8 GiB and 10.9 GiB, respectively.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Re-rendering over 40-second held-out rollouts. For each game, the upper row is the low-poly proxy from the engine and the lower row is the frame generated by the distilled causal model at the same time step. The generated frames follow the proxy layout, camera, and object motion throughout the rollout, while the model fills in materials, vegetation, lighting, smoke, and muzzle effects.
blocks.zh: 图7:重新交付超过40秒的搁置推出。 对每款游戏来说,上行是引擎产生的低波力代位,下行是同时步骤蒸馏因果模型产生的帧. 生成的帧沿着代理布局,相机,以及整个推出过程中的物体运动,而模型则充满了材料,植被,照明,烟雾,和口罩效应.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows three held-out rollouts at four time steps. The generated frames keep the layout of the proxy: buildings, walls, trees, and vehicles appear where the proxy places them, and the camera follows the same path. The model adds what the proxy omits. Flat-colored blocks become stone walls, thatched houses, palm trees, sandstone buildings, and city facades; the box-shaped player becomes a textured character; and combat produces smoke, sparks, and projectile trails. The look of each scene stays stable over the 40 seconds, and the character keeps its appearance from the first chunk to the last.
blocks.zh: 图7显示在四个时间步骤下三次暂停推出。 生成的帧保持了代理的布局:建筑物,墙壁,树木,以及车辆在代理放置的地方出现,相机遵循相同的路径. 该模型添加了代理省略的内容. 平面彩色的块成为石墙,锯木屋,棕榈树,砂岩建筑,以及城市外观;箱形的玩家成为纹理化的人物;战斗产生烟雾,火花和抛射痕迹. 每个场景的外观在40秒内保持稳定,角色保持其从第一块到最后块的外观.

blocks.en: 6.4 Gameplay Customization with the Coding Agent
blocks.zh: 6.4 游戏游戏自定义与编码代理

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Game modes written with the coding agent, rendered in real time. Top: in the third-person shooter, the agent adds health and ammunition control, shield durability, a faster shotgun, a game-over condition, and simple sound effects. Middle: in the driving game, the agent implements a time trial with route checkpoints and collision penalties. Bottom: the same driving game turned into a pursuit mode, in which the player must intercept a target vehicle and stay close to it for five seconds. The engine evaluates every rule; the video model renders each frame from the engine output.
blocks.zh: 图8:用编码代理编写的游戏模式,实时渲染. 顶部:在第三人称射手中,代理机增加了健康和弹药控制,盾牌耐久性,更快速的散弹枪,游戏过关条件,以及简单的音效. 中间:在驾驶游戏中,特工执行时间试验,设置路线检查站和碰撞处罚. 底部:同一款驱动游戏变为追逐模式,玩家必须在其中拦截目标车辆,并贴近它5秒. 引擎评价每个规则;视频模型使每个帧从引擎输出.

blocks.en: With the coding agent, a player can customize a game in natural language on top of the existing game code: reshape the terrain, place scene objects, change NPC behavior and interaction logic, or design an entirely new mode. A shooter where everyone fights alone can become a team battle, and a classic time trial can become a cops-and-robbers chase. Figure 8 shows three modes built this way. The shooter gains health and ammunition control, a shield with limited durability, a shotgun with a higher fire rate, a game-over condition at zero health, and simple sound effects. The driving game gains a time trial with checkpoints, collision penalties, and drifting, and a pursuit mode in which the player intercepts a target vehicle. All of these rules run in the engine, and the video model renders whatever the engine outputs. We encourage creators to adapt and extend the released game code to explore further gameplay.
blocks.zh: 有了编码代理,玩家可以在现有的游戏代码之上自定义自然语言的游戏:重塑地形,放置场景对象,改变NPC的行为和交互逻辑,或者设计全新的模式. 一个人单打独斗的枪手可以成为团队战,经典的时间试验可以成为警察与抢劫的追逐. 图8显示了以这种方式构建的三种模式. 枪手获得健康和弹药控制,盾牌耐久性有限,猎枪射击率较高,零健康状态下比赛过关,音效简单. 驾驶游戏获得时间试验与检查站,碰撞处罚,以及漂移,玩家拦截目标车辆的追逐模式. 所有这些规则都运行在引擎中,视频模型使任何引擎输出. 我们鼓励创作者修改和扩展发行的游戏代码,以进一步探索游戏游戏.

blocks.en: 7.2 Code-Defined Worlds Rendered by Video Models
blocks.zh: 7.2 定码世界 由视频模型制作

blocks.en: A recent line of work assigns state and rules to executable code and rendering to a video model. In Code World Model, a coding agent writes code that maintains the world state, and a proxy video compiled from that state conditions a fine-tuned MiniMax-H3 renderer Chen et al. (2026) . Streaming Code World Model turns this renderer into a causal streaming generator distilled to four steps with DMD, which generates each 17-frame chunk in 5.1 s on one H200 Liao and Liu (2026) . Programmable World Model has an agent translate instructions into programs of entity states and transition rules, executes them in a lightweight engine that also keeps off-screen entities, and renders the compiled 3D bounding boxes through a ControlNet attached to a pretrained video model Huang et al. (2026b) . Code Video Model writes Three.js programs that lay out scenes, object motion, and cameras, and conditions a frozen MiniMax-H3 on the resulting proxy video only in the early denoising steps, without additional training Liang et al. (2026) . StreamRender-H3 drives a two-step streaming renderer built on MiniMax-H3 with the semantic maps of a code game engine Lu et al. (2026) , on top of the Sol inference engine Li et al. (2026) . AgentGarten couples simulators and game engines with a shared neural renderer and uses the resulting worlds to train agents Chi et al. (2026) . CoDeR builds executable worlds in code through coordinated roles and renders them with video generation models Fang et al. (2026b) , and Magpie separates a game engine that resolves player actions from a render server that generates visuals from engine frames Zhan et al. (2026) . Mora combines a coding agent, 3D generation, and a video model to build puzzle, multiplayer, and physics games that are played in the cloud Meshy Research Team (2026) , and EdenLive renders the reference videos produced by upstream game programs into detailed frames with a four-step block-autoregressive model Huang et al. (2026a) . Matrix-Game 4.0 follows the same division of labor and is designed for interactive latency on one consumer GPU: it reaches 112 ms from key press to frame on a single RTX 5090 (Table 3 ), and it adds a coding agent that edits the game rules and writes the prompts during play.
blocks.zh: 最近一行的工作指派了州和规则来执行代码和渲染视频模型. 在Code World Model中,一个编码代理写出维持世界状态的代码,以及从该状态条件编译的代理视频,一个微调的MiniMax-H3渲染器陈等人(2026年). 流码世界模型将这个渲染器变成一个因果流动发生器,蒸馏成四步DMD,在1架H200辽和刘(2026)上产生每架5.1秒的17帧块. 可编程 World Model有一个代理将指令翻译为实体状态和过渡规则的程序,在同样保持屏蔽实体的轻量级引擎中执行指令,并通过一个ControlNet将编译的3D绑定盒附在预训视频模型Huang等人(2026b)上. 代码视频 model写了Tree.js程序, 列出场景、物体运动和相机, StreamRender-H3驱动在MiniMax-H3上搭建的双步流线渲染器,配有代码游戏引擎Lu等人(2026年)的语义图,顶部为Sol推论引擎Li等人(2026年). Agent Garten 夫妇模拟器和游戏引擎带有共享的神经渲染器,并利用由此产生的世界来训练代理商. Chi等 (2026) (中文(简体) ). CoDeR通过协调角色在代码中构建可执行世界,使其与视频生成模型Fang et al. (2026b),而Magpie将解决玩家动作的游戏引擎从生成视觉的渲染服务器与引擎帧分离. 詹等 (2026) (中文(简体) ). Mora结合了一个编码代理,3D世代,以及构建谜题的视频模型,多人游戏,和在云梅希研究团队(2026年)中播放的物理游戏,EdenLive将上游游戏程序制作的参考视频编成一个四步块-自动递归模式黄等人(2026年a)的详细帧. Matrix-Game 4.0遵循相同的分工,设计在一个消费的GPU上进行互动延时:它从按键压到在单张RTX 5090(表3)上帧达到112ms,并增加了一个编辑游戏规则的编码代理,并在游戏期间写出提示.

blocks.en: 7.3 Neural Rendering and Structure-Conditioned Video Generation
blocks.zh: 7.3 神经渲染和结构条件化视频生成

blocks.en: Neural rendering combines learned generative models with the structure of the graphics pipeline Tewari et al. (2020) ; Tewari et al. (2022) . Enhancing Photorealism Enhancement translates rendered game frames toward photographs using G-buffers from the renderer Richter et al. (2023) , GameGAN learns a game renderer with a memory module from frames and actions Kim et al. (2020) , and DLSS 5 adds photoreal lighting and materials to game frames in real time NVIDIA (2026) . vid2vid and World-Consistent vid2vid convert semantic maps into temporally coherent video, the latter keeping revisited regions consistent through projected 3D guidance Wang et al. (2018) ; Mallya et al. (2020) . With diffusion models, ControlNet and VideoComposer add spatial and temporal controls to pretrained generators Zhang et al. (2023) ; Wang et al. (2023) ; Cosmos-Transfer1 turns segmentation, depth, and edge maps into realistic video NVIDIA et al. (2025) ; and DiffusionRenderer and FrameDiffuser synthesize video from G-buffers Liang et al. (2025) ; Beisswenger et al. (2025) . AlayaRenderer-Flash distills a G-buffer-conditioned renderer into a four-step autoregressive model that runs at 31.5 FPS at 832 × 448 832\times 448 on one H200 Lin et al. (2026) , and SolarRenderer follows arbitrary structure inputs, including skeletons, sketches, and point clouds, through the reference pathway of MiniMax-H3 and renders them in four steps Fang et al. (2026a) . Our rendering model starts from the Wan2.2 Fun Control weights alibaba-pai (2025) ; aigc-apps (2026) , conditions on the low-poly proxy video rendered by the game engine, and is trained on pixel-aligned UE5 pairs.

blocks.en: 7.4 Real-Time Autoregressive Video Generation
blocks.zh: 7.4 实时自动视频生成

blocks.en: Streaming generation produces video chunk by chunk. Diffusion Forcing and Rolling Diffusion assign different noise levels across frames Chen et al. (2024) ; Ruhe et al. (2024) , and StreamDiT trains on a moving frame buffer for real-time text-to-video Kodaira et al. (2026) . Distribution matching distillation (DMD) turns a multi-step diffusion model into a one-step or few-step generator Yin et al. (2024b) ; Yin et al. (2024a) . CausVid applies DMD to convert a bidirectional video model into a causal one Yin et al. (2025) ; Self Forcing and Self-Forcing++ train on the student’s own KV-cached rollouts Huang et al. (2025) ; Cui et al. (2025) ; Causal Forcing initializes the student from an autoregressive teacher Zhu et al. (2026) ; and Causal Forcing++ uses causal consistency distillation to reach frame-wise generation with one or two steps Zhao et al. (2026) . We follow Causal Forcing++ to distill our bidirectional rendering model. At the systems level, CUDA Graphs NVIDIA (2024) , FlashAttention and split-KV decoding Dao et al. (2022) ; Dao (2024) ; Dao et al. (2023) , FP8 arithmetic Micikevicius et al. (2022) , Triton kernels Tillet et al. (2019) , and the TAEHV decoder Boer Bohan (2025) supply the components of our inference stack.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 8 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en:
Matrix-Game 4.0 separates game execution from visual generation
through an executable game harness. Game code defines the rules,
a lightweight engine maintains persistent world state, and a video
model generates the visuals in real time. A coding agent connects
user ideas to executable game code, enabling scenes, interactions,
and gameplay to be created and iteratively refined through
natural-language instructions and interactive play.

blocks.en:
On a single NVIDIA RTX 5090, the renderer achieves 83 FPS
steady-state generation throughput at 480p with one denoising step.
The integrated system achieves a measured key-press-to-display
latency of 112 ms in our evaluated configuration. The pipeline
spans paired UE5 gameplay data, dynamic semantic conditioning,
causal adaptation, few-step distillation, and optimized inference,
providing a reusable foundation for adapting this approach to
additional games. For researchers, Matrix-Game 4.0 offers a
technical basis for investigating this emerging paradigm.
For game developers, it provides a concrete preview of a
game-development workflow that combines natural-language
prototyping, engine-enforced mechanics, and neural rendering.

blocks.en:
In the near term, we will focus on reducing inference cost and
hardware requirements, with the goal of releasing a technical
preview on Steam. Further directions include improving visual
fidelity, incorporating a refinement stage for higher-resolution
output, exploring multiplayer rendering with consistent views
across players, enabling more precise control over generated
visuals, and extending the system to a broader range of game
genres and scenes.
